description: This file defines a PreferencesRepository class that manages user settings using Android's DataStore. It provides methods to retrieve and save user preferences such as stream URL, language settings, auto-translate toggle, and translation latency.

classes.name: UserSettings
classes.description: Data class representing user preferences such as stream URL, translation settings, and optional sidecar VTT URL.

classes.name: PreferencesRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to get and set user preferences stored in DataStore.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Suspended function to asynchronously retrieve user settings from DataStore.

methods.name: getSettingsSync
methods.description: Synchronous wrapper around getSettings using runBlocking.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Suspended function to save user settings to DataStore.

methods.name: saveLanguages
methods.description: Suspended function to save source and destination languages.

methods.name: setAutoTranslate
methods.description: Suspended function to enable or disable auto translate feature.

methods.name: toSettings
methods.description: Extension function converting Preferences object to UserSettings data class.
